title: 文件编辑
description: 用本机编辑器修改工作副本，在编辑中视图完成保存、预览或恢复处理。
author: 资源管理器项目

catalog.usage: 右键编辑文件，外部保存后在“编辑中”完成；停用和卸载只隐藏界面，工作副本仍由宿主保留。

en.打开已有工作副本，更换编辑器不会复制第二份。外部保存并关闭后，再回到应用完成编辑: Opens the existing working copy. Switching editors reuses that copy. Save and close in the external editor, then return here to finish.
In this library, use this app by default for .
en.此文件没有扩展名，本次选择不会应用到其他无扩展名文件。: This file has no extension. This choice applies only to this file.
en.已打开工作副本；外部保存并关闭后，在“编辑中”完成编辑: Working copy opened. Save and close it in the external app, then finish in Editing.
en.编辑已完成，工作副本已清理: Editing finished. Working copy cleaned up.
en.请先在外部应用保存并关闭文件；完成后清理工作副本: Save and close in the external app first. Finishing will clean up the working copy.
en.先在外部应用中保存并关闭文件，再完成编辑。完成后保留原有版本、更新本库内容，并清: Save and close the file in the external app first. Finishing preserves earlier versions, updates this library and removes the local working copy.
en.将发布共享文件的新版本；其他仓库按各自规则接纳。: A new shared version will be published. Other libraries accept it according to their own rules.
en.。空间保留已保存版本；请先核对素材，再决定是否清理工作副本。: . The space retains the saved version. Check the item before cleaning up the working copy.
en.保存到独享空间，并切换当前素材的引用；原文件及其他仓库保持原状。: Save to an exclusive space and switch this item’s reference. The original and other libraries are preserved.
en.没有新修改，完成编辑只清理工作副本: No new changes. Finishing will only remove the working copy.
en.重新检查／更换保存方式: Check again or change save method
en.标签、笔记等数据保留，派生内容重新生成；正文位置相关的批注需自行核对。: Tags and notes are retained. Derived content is regenerated. Check annotations that refer to positions in the text.
en.删除此工作副本和预览快照，未保存的修改将丢失。素材与已有空间版本保留。请先关闭外: Deletes the working copy and preview snapshot. Unsaved changes will be lost. The item and existing space versions are preserved. Close the external editor first.
en.当前仓库在这台电脑上的工作副本: Working copies for this library on this device
en.没有正在编辑的文件。可以从素材右键菜单开始编辑。: No files are being edited. Start from an item’s context menu.
en.双击继续编辑；选中一项后完成编辑。普通查看仍使用本库已接纳版本。: Double-click to resume, or select an item to finish editing. Normal viewing uses the version accepted by this library.
en.需要单独处理的工作副本 · 素材不可用或旧任务已结束: Working copies needing attention · Item unavailable or previous task ended
en.“编辑中”按工作副本状态汇集素材；请到普通视图收录或新建素材: Editing lists working copies. Use an ordinary view to collect or create items.
en.用本机编辑器修改工作副本，在编辑中视图完成保存、预览或恢复处理。: Edit working copies in a local editor and preview, finish or recover edits in the Editing view.
en.右键编辑文件，外部保存后在“编辑中”完成；停用和卸载只隐藏界面，工作副本仍由宿主: Choose Edit file, save in the external editor and finish in Editing. Disabling or uninstalling the plugin hides its UI; the host retains working copies.
